decisions.reason: The carpet floor cushions are a low-cost accessory that reuses rug materials and supports the rug collection, though as a niche item four years old they are a candidate for range pruning.
The upholstered sofa fits the core residential offer, but its weak web presence and the normal model rotation in premium furniture make a withdrawal plausible.
A high standing table serves the flexible office and lounge settings the firm is moving toward and costs little to keep in the range.
The rug collection is presented as a flagship of the firm's design direction, so management is likely to keep backing it despite its distance from the core business.
